sentences.text: Report a marine casualty to the nearest Coast Guard sector or station immediately, as soon as you’ve dealt with the emergency.
Then file a written report on Form C G twenty-six ninety-two within five days.
If the casualty is a serious marine incident, such as one involving a death or serious injury, drug and alcohol testing is also required, with alcohol testing within two hours.
Keep your logbook entries, photos and the names of witnesses.
Accidents on recreational boats are reported to the state instead.
